<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
full(shape: Any, fill_value: Any, dtype: Optional[Any] = None, device: Optional[Device] = None) -> Tensor
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Create a concrete tensor filled with `fill_value`.

## Parameters

- `shape` · `Any` — The concrete shape (tuple/list of ints).

- `fill_value` · `Any` — Scalar value to fill with.

- `dtype` · `Optional[Any]` — Element dtype; defaults to numpy inference from
  `fill_value`, except an inferred `float64` becomes `float32`
  (the library's documented default dtype; integer fills keep
  `int64`).

- `device` · `Optional[Device]` — Optional target device — only `None` (default) or
  `Device("cpu", 0)` (host memory; other devices need an
  explicit `Tensor.to` transfer).

## Returns

- `Tensor` — The new concrete `Tensor`.

## Raises

- `DeviceError` — If `device` is anything but `Device("cpu", 0)`.
